translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: LUCAS
book.title: Dos Moppiyon Dinoggan no id Sulat ni LUCAS

content: Dos Moka‑atag to Minuvu nod Okoy to Duma riyot Kodpuung to Saa
Na mid ikahi si Disas diyot mgo tinodduwan din to, “Duwon en unayan nod pokopuung to saa kos minuvu. Piru moka‑arat‑arat kod kotomanan taddot ahad ondoy nod poko‑okoy to duma riyot kodpuung to saa.

Moppiya pa nod ikottan kos liyog din to oray'n dakkoon gilingan no batu woy id lumbag diyon to dahat, su amoy dii sikandin od poko‑okoy to duma riyot kodpuung to saa, ahad pe‑en ka‑ay't disok no mgo anak.
De‑en pa‑ayyad‑ayyad kow. “Otik iddos suwod du riyot kopomakoy, nokosaa kikow, sugga‑aw sikandin. Otid sondit woy'd tanan sikandin to saa rin, posinsya‑iyu.
Otik nokosaa sikandin kikow to kopittu daom to sokkad no allow, woy kopittu mandad sikandin od buyu kikow to posinsya, posinsya‑iyu sikandin.”
Moka‑atag to Kopomakoy
Na id osengan si Disas taddot mgo apostoles, kahi ran to, “Longaggon, pomosolihow pe‑en kos kopomakoy roy.”

Kahin Disas kandan to, “Otik duwon kopomakoy row ahad iling da to korisokkoy to bonnit mustasa, od pokosuhu kow ruwot dakkoon kayu nod ungketen to, ‘Od kookkat ka woy alin ka riyot dahat.’ Na, od tuman en ini koniyu.”
Dos Kotundanan to Sudsuhuwon

Na mid ikahi mandon si Disas to, “Ponunggeleng, duwon sudsuhuwon dow no id dadu riyot kamot o id tamong to mgo oyama. Otik lammi pa sikandin id inguma pomon to kodpuung, dii row en sikandin od osengan to, ‘Na undini ka, woy ka‑an kad.’
Konna en! Od ikohiyan dow baling sikandin to, ‘Na ilis kad, woy oilutu kad atag koddi woy kopongnga, sondari a. Otid pokopongnga ad, suvaa kad bo ka‑an.’
Konnad ko‑ilangan nod posolomatan dow iddon sudsuhuwon, oyyos id puungan din da me‑en kos kotundanan din.

Na ungketen dad en mandad koniyu. Otik nopuungan dowd iddos id popuungan to Monama koniyu, osenga row ra no, ‘Mgo sudsuhuwon koy ra no konna ollog nod doongon, oyyos id puungan doy ra kos kotundanan doy.’ ”
Dos Sopuun Minuvu no duwon Bohok no Et‑et no No‑uliyan
Na, to id ponayun si Disas nid undiyon to Jerusalem, id ukit sikandin diyot ollot to Samaria woy Galilea.
To kod‑inguma rin diyot sokkad no bariyu, mid sinuggung kandin iddos sopuun minuvu no duwon bohok no et‑et
woy id soro sikandan diyot moriyu boyow.
Id nganoy sikandan ki Disas, kahi ran to, “Disas nod Longaggon, ko‑eruwan ka konami!”
To nokita sikandan ni Disas, mid ikahi sikandin to, “Undiyon kow to mgo tohodbuwis amoy'd ontongngan dan ko no‑uliyan kowd.” Woy to riyon pa sikandan to daan, no‑uliyan dan don.
Na iddos sokkad kandan, to nokita rin no no‑uliyan don sikandin, id poolivod sikandin diyot ki Disas woy id pehes to koddoong to Monama.
Mid lingko‑od sikandin diyot isowwan ni Disas woy id posolamat kandin. Iddon minuvu, toho Samaria.
Na mid intud si Disas kandin, kahi rin to, “Konna vo sopuu man kos no‑uliyan? Ingkon don man kos siyow?
Mambo man to ini ra so konna Judio kos id livod amoy'd posolamat to Monama?”
Na kahin Disas kandin to, “Lohinat ka woy uli kad bo. No‑uliyan ka pomon to kopomakoy ru.”
Dos Kod‑inguma to Kodharit Monama
Sokkad no timpu, duwon mgo Pariseo nid intud ki Disas ko kannu od tigkanoy iddos kodharit Monama. Mid tavak si Disas to, “Waa mgo kilaannan nod kokita row otid tigkanoy ron kos kodharit Monama.
Waa mandad od poko‑ikahi to, ‘Ontongngi row, ini rad’ o ‘Idda rad‑i,’ oyya su iddos kodharit Monama, ka‑ay en to koniyu.”

Na kahin Disas diyot mgo tinodduwan din to, “Od inguma en kos timpu no od ingowollon dow nod pokokita to ahad sokkad da taddot mgo allow to kodhari ku no Anak to Minuvu, piru dii row pa idda od kokita.
Duwon mgo minuvu nod ikahi koniyu to, ‘Diyon dad sikandin lomig’ o ‘Ini rad sikandin.’ Na, yo kow ron en od pomakoy kandan.
Oyya su iddos kodlivod ku no Anak to Minuvu, od kokita to langun ka‑ay to ampow't ingod iling to tigkow no kodse‑aa to kilat.
Piru to dii pa ini od kotomanan, ko‑ilangan nod ukit a pa to mgo kodposuppit woy'd elleyan a to mgo minuvu to inin timpu.
Iddos pinuungan to mgo minuvu riyot kodlivod ku no Anak to Minuvu, od poko‑iling taddot pinuungan to mgo minuvu iddot timpu ni Noe.
Su iddon timpu, iyon id pompuungan to mgo minuvu, iddos kodka‑an, kod‑oinom woy kodpo‑osoway taman to allow nid usok si Noe riyot arka. Na, id inguma iddos dakkoon lanog woy langun dan, nongoonnod.
Ungketen dad en mandad kos pinuungan to mgo minuvu iddot timpu ni Lot. Su mid ka‑an sikandan, id oinom, id bovolli, id bovoligya, id pomuwa woy id bovaoy.
Piru to id awa onsi Lot pomon diyot Sodoma, tigkow idda id po‑uranan to apuy woy asupre no id pomon diyot datas to langit, woy id poomatoy kos langun.
Na, ungketen dad en mandad kos od kotomanan to mgo minuvu riyot allow nod pokita ad no Anak to Minuvu.

“Otid inguma ron iddon allow, iddos minuvu no riyot atop to baoy rin, ko‑ilangan no dii ron od usok diyot baoy amoy'd ponemmos pa. Idda mandad so minuvu no riyot kamot din, ko‑ilangan no dii ron od uli.
Sompotta row iddos notomanan to sawa ni Lot.
Dos ahad ondoy nod konuhunan to umuu rin, od koworan da en baling tadda. Piru iddos od dumoruma koddi ahad od undag idda to kopotayan din, duwon umuun waad tomanon.
Od ikohiyan ku sikiyu, no iddon bulli, otik duwon oruwon minuvu nid poruuhoy to kodtinuhon, dos sokkad od ongayon woy dos sokkad, od kotuwos.
Otik duwon oruwon ba‑ay nod gohiling, dos sokkad, od ongayon woy dos sokkad, od kotuwos.
[Otik duwon oruwon mama nod puung diyot kamot, dos sokkad od ongayon woy dos sokkad, od kotuwos.”]

Na mid intud kandin iddos mgo tinodduwan din, kahi ran to, “Longaggon, ingkon man ini od kotomanan?” Mid tavak si Disas ukit to ponunggelengan no mid ungketen to, “Otid kokita nod lolivuung iddos mgo uwak, od kosorollan no morani kos bangkoy. Iling mandad tadda, otid kokita iddos mgo kilaannan, od kosorollan no morani ron kos kotompusan to ingod.”

footnotes.text: Inis et‑et, moka‑arat‑arat no bohok no moomok nod alin diyot duma. Iddos duwon bohok no iling ka‑ay, diid geddam to mosakit ahad od kooddak don kos sapu rin. Od kovasa ini riyot Levitico 13:45-46.
Od kovasa ini riyot Genesis 18:20 taman to 19:29.
